title: World Liquor 0.1.189: match Java eye-water surface precision
native_evidence_scope: Source regression fixes the Java float-addition boundary in eyesUnderWater and exercises the real Captain Gift correction at that boundary. Existing W188 source/native water-height, stop/reacquisition and same-world restart observations retain their original scope; they are not rerun or relabeled as new W189 native evidence. No new native boundary observation or full ground/fall-distance parity is claimed.
public_notes_inline: Eye-water contact now adds block Y and fluid height as Java float before comparing to the eye position. This prevents eyes exactly at the original surface from being treated as submerged and preserves the negative-Y boundary. Water-walking geometry, physics, UUIDs and saved formats are unchanged.
peer_pin_note: Unchanged exact T200 dependency and G220 optional CI peer; no external effect schema or saved-data format changes. Complete-family saved-world gates and deployment remain separate.
